response:
It is completely understandable that you are feeling anxious and demoralized. Being overworked and undervalued in a high-stress tech environment is incredibly draining, and your feelings are a natural response to that imbalance. To help manage this stress, a crucial first step is setting firm boundaries. Try to strictly separate your work hours from your personal time by turning off notifications and stepping away from your screens when the workday ends. During the day, taking short, regular breaks to stretch or practice deep breathing can help reset your nervous system. 

Beyond daily stress management, consider if there is room to have a candid conversation with your manager about prioritizing your workload. Since your environment is impacting your self-worth, it is vital to invest time in activities outside of work that remind you of your value. If the anxiety becomes overwhelming, speaking with a career counselor or a mental health professional could provide tailored strategies to help you navigate this difficult situation.
